notes: NARRATOR CORRECTION: Elizabeth Evans narrates Throne of Glass and Crescent City, not ACOTAR. Standard ACOTAR audiobooks: Jennifer Ikeda (books 1-2), Amanda Leigh Cobb (book 3 & novella), Stina Nielsen (A Court of Silver Flames).
The Assassin's Blade (Throne of Glass novella collection) is intentionally excluded from the tog series -- main 7 novels only. 772 min / 435 pages if you want to add it later.

A Court of Splintered Harmony (ACOTAR book 6, releasing 2026-10-27) is confirmed via sarahjmaas.com/Variety but has no audiobook or page count yet since it hasn't released -- it is NOT listed in the series array above so it doesn't get double counted as something to 'read' before its own release; update this file once official numbers exist if you want it included in future totals.
A Court of Forgotten Melody (ACOTAR book 7) is confirmed for 2027-01-12 but out of scope for this release countdown.

PAGE COUNT VARIANCE (editions differ, lower confidence): Crown of Midnight (432 vs 448, used 448), A Court of Frost and Starlight (229, thin sourcing), House of Flame and Shadow (816 vs 848, used 816).
AUDIOBOOK LENGTH VARIANCE: Throne of Glass cited as both 12h47m and 13h3m -- used 783 min (13h3m), medium confidence. All others corroborated by 2+ sources.
Crescent City book 4 is confirmed to exist eventually but has no title/date/numbers yet -- omitted rather than guessed.
Sources: Audible.com/.ca, Libro.fm, Goodreads editions pages, readinglength.com, howlongtoread.com, Booklist Queen, sarahjmaas.com, Variety.com.
